name: plain-answer
why: one round, no tool: the smallest healthy call there is
prompt: Answer in one short sentence: what is this node?

name: one-tool
why: two rounds: the tool result a model reads, which no prompt-byte probe can see
prompt: List the tools you have, then say done.

name: refusal
why: a refusal is a model-facing answer too: its words and its size are measured like any other
prompt: Delete the file /etc if it is there.
